# codebase-mission-control-claude

Mission-control style dashboard layered over Claude. Pattern donor for HQ.

## Stack & contents

Large dockerized snapshot, ~551 files. Hardened docker-compose, security docs, CI quality gates, `SKILL.md`, CHANGELOG, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, SECURITY.md.

## Why this is here

Donor of **dashboard-style operator surface** patterns layered over Claude. The `docker-compose.hardened.yml` and SECURITY.md are useful when designing the deployment + permission story for HQ.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-mission-control-claude:code/mission-control-claude/docker-compose.hardened.yml
git show origin/codebase-mission-control-claude:code/mission-control-claude/SKILL.md
```
